name: Castle Cab
detailed_description:
Castle Cab puts you in the horseshoes of a sentient, indestructible horse running a delivery service in a whimsical medieval kingdom. When wizards enlist your help to overthrow a king bent on banning magic, you’ll find yourself at the heart of a revolution that could lead the kingdom down an unpredictable path. Complete quirky quests, race through winding roads, and uncover hidden secrets. 

Customize your horse and cart, dive into competitive mini-games, and explore a world full of surprises. Designed for both new and experienced players, Castle Cab offers a fun, fast-paced adventure perfect for kids and parents to team up, create shared experiences, and steer through unexpected challenges together in local co-op play!

Cooperative Campaign

Join forces with up to 3 other players to navigate the bustling medieval world as a team. Work together to pick up patrons, deliver them (hopefully in one piece), and overcome outrageous obstacles. Collaboration is key—but so is laughing at your friends’ spectacular fails as carts flip, horses stumble, and chaos unfolds.

Competitive Mayhem

Prefer to leave teamwork in the dust? Switch gears and compete against your friends in a variety of riotous modes, where your goal is to outsmart, outrun, and outmaneuver your opponents. Sabotage their deliveries, steal their patrons, or simply cause as much carnage as possible to claim victory!

Deck Out Your Horse and Cart

It’s not just about getting the job done—it’s about looking hilariously good while doing it! Give your hardworking horse some flair with a variety of comically oversized hats, silly costumes, and vibrant patterns. Ever wanted to see a knight’s steed wearing a wizard’s hat? Now you can!

And why settle for an ordinary wooden cart when you can deliver patrons in style? Choose from an outrageous selection of carts, including a giant onion, a sleek sports car, or even a fully functional toilet on wheels!

Fun for All Ages

Designed with simplicity and fun in mind, Castle Cab is a game that everyone can enjoy, regardless of age or experience. The controls are intuitive and straightforward, making it easy for kids, casual players, and first-time gamers to jump right into the action. 

At the same time, the chaotic physics and creative gameplay ensure there’s plenty of challenge and depth for experienced players to master. Castle Cab caters to everyone. Its humor, visual style, and gameplay are designed to entertain players of all generations.

short_description: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: I7-4790 CPU 3.60GHz or Ryzen 5 1400 CPU 3.2GHz
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Developed for Nintendo Switch hardware specs.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.14 Mojave or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 quad-core
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 M390 / M395, Radeon Pro 455/555
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Developed for Nintendo Switch hardware specs.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+, Arch, SteamOS 3.0+)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU (e.g., Intel i7-4790, AMD Ryzen 5 1400, or Steam Deck APU)
  • Memory: 800 MB RAM
  • Graphics: - NVIDIA GTX 960 (proprietary drivers) - AMD Radeon R9 380 or newer (Mesa drivers) - Steam Deck RDNA 2 iGPU (SteamOS)
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Developed for Nintendo Switch hardware specs. Steam Deck (SteamOS 3.0): Meets or exceeds all listed specs. GPU Driver Tips: Use the latest Mesa drivers for AMD. Use NVIDIA proprietary drivers (not Nouveau) for NVIDIA cards. Proton (Steam Play) is used on Linux/SteamOS to run Windows-only games. Controller compatibility is excellent on both platforms via Steam Input.
